en.text: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

zhSimplified.text: 从前在百姓中有假先知起来，将来在你们中间也必有假师傅，私自引进陷害人的异端，连买他们的主他们也不承认，自取速速地灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 從前在百姓中有假先知起來，將來在你們中間也必有假師傅，私自引進陷害人的異端，連買他們的主他們也不承認，自取速速地滅亡。

en.text: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

zhSimplified.text: 将有许多人随从他们邪淫的行为，便叫真道因他们的缘故被毁谤。

zhTraditional.text: 將有許多人隨從他們邪淫的行為，便叫真道因他們的緣故被毀謗。

en.text: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

zhSimplified.text: 他们因有贪心，要用捏造的言语在你们身上取利。他们的刑罚，自古以来并不迟延；他们的灭亡也必速速来到。

zhTraditional.text: 他們因有貪心，要用捏造的言語在你們身上取利。他們的刑罰，自古以來並不遲延；他們的滅亡也必速速來到。

en.text: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

footnotes.text: 2:4 Tartarus is another name for Hell

zhSimplified.text: 就是天使犯了罪， 神也没有宽容，曾把他们丢在地狱，交在黑暗坑中，等候审判。

zhTraditional.text: 就是天使犯了罪，上帝也沒有寬容，曾把他們丟在地獄，交在黑暗坑中，等候審判。

en.text: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

zhSimplified.text: 神也没有宽容上古的世代，曾叫洪水临到那不敬虔的世代，却保护了传义道的挪亚一家八口。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝也沒有寬容上古的世代，曾叫洪水臨到那不敬虔的世代，卻保護了傳義道的挪亞一家八口。

en.text: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

zhSimplified.text: 又判定所多玛、蛾摩拉，将二城倾覆，焚烧成灰，作为后世不敬虔人的鉴戒；

zhTraditional.text: 又判定所多瑪、蛾摩拉，將二城傾覆，焚燒成灰，作為後世不敬虔人的鑑戒；

en.text: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

zhSimplified.text: 只搭救了那常为恶人淫行忧伤的义人罗得。（

zhTraditional.text: 只搭救了那常為惡人淫行憂傷的義人羅得。（

en.text: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

zhSimplified.text: 因为那义人住在他们中间，看见听见他们不法的事，他的义心就天天伤痛。）

zhTraditional.text: 因為那義人住在他們中間，看見聽見他們不法的事，他的義心就天天傷痛。）

en.text: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

zhSimplified.text: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脱离试探，把不义的人留在刑罚之下，等候审判的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脫離試探，把不義的人留在刑罰之下，等候審判的日子。

en.text: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

zhSimplified.text: 那些随肉身、纵污秽的情欲、轻慢主治之人的，更是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 那些隨肉身、縱污穢的情慾、輕慢主治之人的，更是如此。

en.text: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 就是天使，虽然力量权能更大，还不用毁谤的话在主面前告他们。

zhTraditional.text: 就是天使，雖然力量權能更大，還不用毀謗的話在主面前告他們。

en.text: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

zhSimplified.text: 但这些人好像没有灵性，生来就是畜类，以备捉拿宰杀的。他们毁谤所不晓得的事，正在败坏人的时候，自己必遭遇败坏。

zhTraditional.text: 但這些人好像沒有靈性，生來就是畜類，以備捉拿宰殺的。他們毀謗所不曉得的事，正在敗壞人的時候，自己必遭遇敗壞。

en.text: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

zhSimplified.text: 行的不义，就得了不义的工价。这些人喜爱白昼宴乐，他们已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正与你们一同坐席，就以自己的诡诈为快乐。

zhTraditional.text: 行的不義，就得了不義的工價。這些人喜愛白晝宴樂，他們已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正與你們一同坐席，就以自己的詭詐為快樂。

en.text: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

zhSimplified.text: 他们满眼是淫色，止不住犯罪，引诱那心不坚固的人，心中习惯了贪婪，正是被咒诅的种类。

zhTraditional.text: 他們滿眼是淫色，止不住犯罪，引誘那心不堅固的人，心中習慣了貪婪，正是被咒詛的種類。

en.text: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

zhSimplified.text: 他们离弃正路，就走差了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路。巴兰就是那贪爱不义之工价的先知，

zhTraditional.text: 他們離棄正路，就走差了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路。巴蘭就是那貪愛不義之工價的先知，

en.text: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

zhSimplified.text: 他却为自己的过犯受了责备；那不能说话的驴以人言拦阻先知的狂妄。

zhTraditional.text: 他卻為自己的過犯受了責備；那不能說話的驢以人言攔阻先知的狂妄。

en.text: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人是无水的井，是狂风催逼的雾气，有墨黑的幽暗为他们存留。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人是無水的井，是狂風催逼的霧氣，有墨黑的幽暗為他們存留。

en.text: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

zhSimplified.text: 他们说虚妄矜夸的大话，用肉身的情欲和邪淫的事引诱那些刚才脱离妄行的人。

zhTraditional.text: 他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，用肉身的情慾和邪淫的事引誘那些剛才脫離妄行的人。

en.text: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

zhSimplified.text: 他们应许人得以自由，自己却作败坏的奴仆，因为人被谁制伏就是谁的奴仆。

zhTraditional.text: 他們應許人得以自由，自己卻作敗壞的奴僕，因為人被誰制伏就是誰的奴僕。

en.text: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

zhSimplified.text: 倘若他们因认识主—救主耶稣基督，得以脱离世上的污秽，后来又在其中被缠住、制伏，他们末后的景况就比先前更不好了。

zhTraditional.text: 倘若他們因認識主－救主耶穌基督，得以脫離世上的污穢，後來又在其中被纏住、制伏，他們末後的景況就比先前更不好了。

en.text: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们晓得义路，竟背弃了传给他们的圣命，倒不如不晓得为妙。

zhTraditional.text: 他們曉得義路，竟背棄了傳給他們的聖命，倒不如不曉得為妙。

en.text: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

zhSimplified.text: 俗语说得真不错： 狗所吐的，它转过来又吃； 猪洗净了又回到泥里去滚； 这话在他们身上正合式。

zhTraditional.text: 俗語說得真不錯： 狗所吐的，牠轉過來又吃； 豬洗淨了又回到泥裏去滾； 這話在他們身上正合式。
